text: dsh-compliancehub 是面向 DSH 的远程技能 provider，通过 ctx.skills 注册技能目录。它从 JSON 目录发现跨境合规技能，并在调用时按需读取对应的 SKILL.md 正文；目录项会经过结构校验，网络或读取失败时返回不完整结果或无技能正文。适合希望让 DSH 按需使用 CCPA、GDPR、HIPAA、COPPA 等主题技能的用户。默认从 wwumit.github.io 获取目录，并从 raw.githubusercontent.com 获取技能正文；无需在插件中配置 API key。

dsh-compliancehub connects a remote JSON catalog to DSH through ctx.skills. It validates entries, lists compliance skills, and fetches each SKILL.md on demand. It defaults to wwumit.github.io for the catalog and raw.githubusercontent.com for skill content; no API key is configured.
想让 DSH 能按需加载 GDPR 或 CCPA 合规技能。
有没有办法把远程 JSON 技能目录接入 DSH 的 skills 注册表？
I want DSH to discover compliance skills from a hosted catalog and load their instructions only when needed.
dsh-compliancehub 的功能「远程技能发现与读取」：注册到 ctx.skills 后，list 从 JSON 目录校验并列出技能，get 根据条目定位并按需取得 SKILL.md 正文。
使用前须知：插件会联网读取 wwumit.github.io 的技能目录，并从 raw.githubusercontent.com 拉取 SKILL.md 正文；没有在插件中配置 API key。
@wwumit/dsh-compliancehub 的维护与更新元数据：活跃维护；距最后推送 84 天；提交数 16；更新频次 unknown；近 90 天提交 未知；开放 Issue 未知；仓库健康分 62/100（置信度 low）。

@wwumit/dsh-compliancehub README · dsh-compliancehub：Remote skill provider for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
install skills from a JSON catalog through the standard `ctx.skills` registry —
no manual folder copying.

本插件**只提供跨境合规线（9 个技能）**：CCPA/GDPR/HIPAA/COPPA 的 check/guard 与 ccpa-compliance。
股票、数据分析、插件工具等其他技能线**不属于本插件**（详见 [wwumit 技能生态](https://github.com/wwumit/skills-catalog)）。
默认目录为线级 `catalog-compliance.json`，主目录 `catalog.json` 仍为全量登记层（开放数据层），保持不变。

@wwumit/dsh-compliancehub README · dsh-compliancehub：- `list()` — fetch + validate a curated catalog, expose its skills to the registry
- `get()` — fetch the `SKILL.md` body on demand from the owning repo
- Fail-soft semantics: a catalog outage yields an *incomplete observation* (consumers
  keep their last-good catalog), never an authoritative empty list

@wwumit/dsh-compliancehub README · Verified (DSH 实机验证)：`verify-dsh.ts` 在真实 DSH 运行时验证通过（SkillRegistry + provider 注册）：

```
✅ ctx.skills.list() → 9 个跨境合规技能（线级 catalog-compliance.json）
✅ ctx.skills.get('ccpa-check') → 正文 {n} 字节
```

- 验证方式：注册 `ctx.skills.registerProvider` → 真实 `list()`/`get()` 调用线上 catalog
- 结果随版本演进记录在 CHANGELOG.md；目录收录方可用此作为"含实测结果"证据

@wwumit/dsh-compliancehub README · Token effect：Zero direct token contribution: the provider only feeds the shared skills catalog,
whose rendering cost is owned by the DSH skill consumer (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill`).

@wwumit/dsh-compliancehub README · KV Cache effect：Independent of model requests; no prompt-prefix contribution, so cache reuse is
unaffected by provider activity.

@wwumit/dsh-compliancehub README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：- **Body-only fetch** — `get()` currently fetches `SKILL.md` only; script/resource
  files listed in the catalog manifest are not yet downloaded into a local cache
  (`resourceBase` resolution is future work).
- **Catalog caching** — `list()` refetches on every call; a TTL cache keyed by the
  resolved catalog URL is planned.
- **Auth** — no support yet for private catalogs or signed URLs.
